summary: Full frontend regression on fuel-log app (GSP Beograd / SP Novi Beograd) at 390x844 viewport. All 23 critical flows pass: login (wrong & 'puzopb'), Smena validations via toast-message (empty bus, bus not on list '1234', duplicate same day, no pump, no qty), suggestions (suggest-7000 for '70'), full save (arrived-count 0->1, recent-7000, recent-delete-7000 wired), date-prev/today returns to Danas with per-date data (count 0 on prev day), Vozila (count '1/276' after one arrival, filter-dosla highlights 7000, vozila-add 9999 + vozilo-remove-9999), Izveštaj (report-arrivals-count=1, report-arrival-7000 rendered, report-total-liters '23,45 L', pump-stat-3 shows 1, report-top-pump 'Pumpa 3 (1)', report-week-total=1), export buttons (week-pdf/share, day-excel/pdf) render without crashing, admin-badge opens sheet, logout-button returns to login screen, data persists after reload (verified via izveštaj screenshot after reload still showing arrival & stats). All UI is in Latin script, no overflow at 390x844. No red-screen errors. No deprecated expo packages detected (uses expo-print, expo-file-system, expo-haptics, expo-image, no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Sheet modal in kit.tsx uses backdrop with flex:1 and sheet beneath without wrapper flex:column; Playwright reported 'Element is outside of the viewport' on logout-button without force=true, though bbox is in viewport (y=712, viewport 844) and click with force=true works correctly. Could add justifyContent:'flex-end' on a wrapper for extra robustness.
Minor: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx uses `useEffect` with 15s interval to refresh time; this still works but could cause small drift. Non-blocking.
No other issues: files are well under 700 lines, all strings Latin, env usage correct (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL present but unused since local-only app).
seed_data_creation: None; tested on fresh storage after localStorage.clear().
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a local-only Expo mobile web app (admin pwd 'puzopb'). Default bus list has 276 numbers including 7000, 7013, 7014, 7016, 8114, 2588. Test at viewport 390x844. All testIDs used by UI: login-password-input, login-submit-button, login-error, arrival-bus-input, suggest-<bus>, pump-chip-1..8, arrival-qty-input, arrival-note-input, arrival-time, arrival-save-button, arrived-count, recent-<bus>, recent-delete-<bus>, admin-badge, admin-sheet, logout-button, admin-close-button, date-prev-button/date-next-button/date-today-button/date-value, tab-index/tab-vozila/tab-izvestaj, vozila-count, vozila-search-input, vozila-add-button, vozila-filter-sva/dosla/nisu, vozilo-<n>, vozilo-remove-<n>, vozila-reset-button, report-arrivals-count, report-arrival-<bus>, report-total-liters, pump-stat-<n>, report-top-pump, report-week-total, week-pdf-button, week-share-button, day-excel-button, day-pdf-button, toast-message. Admin logout requires force=True click due to Playwright modal-viewport quirk.
